known_gaps: An SSN split across two messages is not detected. The service sees one message at a time.
A date written day-then-month, such as 14 March 1985, is not a DOB even next to a birth word.
Nine digits with no separator are redacted as an SSN, so an order number or a ZIP+4 written as nine digits and no hyphen is the same shape. Hyphenated ZIP+4 (12345-6789) is kept.
A driver-license number with no license or dl word next to it is kept. A letter plus digits alone is an order number.
